Still 8 dispatches but reorders computation to enable asynchronous launches and overlapped communication-computation.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Phase Reduction

Restructures dependency chain into 4+3+1 pattern to exploit potential intra-phase parallelism while maintaining correctness, same 8 dispatches but different topology.

strategies.name: Chunked Block Reduce-Scatter All-Gather
strategies.desc: Decomposes the problem by splitting blocks across reduce-scatter operations that distribute partial results, then uses all-gather to reassemble with correct scaling factors applied during the scatter phase. Potentially fewer than 8 dispatches (5-6 RS+AG pairs) by exploiting commutativity of overlapping window operations, trading algorithmic complexity for reduced collective count.
